answer: Sybils splitting into many wallets must post a separate bond per identity, and a terrace of peer attestations ranks contributors, so fake accounts cluster at the bottom and earn nothing. Agents stake a bond into a shared vault before earning reputation; each epoch they must submit a unique proof-of-work plume tied to their identity. Attacker cost scales linearly with each forged identity, making mass sybil farming economically unviable. From qwe0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
